backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining backend logic for bookings and messages with validation, storage in Maps, and public functions to submit and retrieve bookings/messages.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three QR code-related features implemented in Footer.tsx with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, hooks, and configuration for the Friends AC Services website.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode CSS variables for the design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with page title, favicon links, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component rendering the full page layout with Hero, Services, About, Booking, ServiceAreaMap, ContactForm, Footer sections and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section displaying four statistics cards (experience, customers, certifications, support) and a commitment statement with icons and styling.
frontend/src/components/Booking.tsx: Booking form component with inputs for name, phone, email, service type selector, date picker, and time slot selection, submitting to backend via useBookingForm hook.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Contact form with message textarea and contact info cards displaying phone numbers, email, and location, submitting via useContactForm hook.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying company info, contact details (phone, email, location), business hours, social media links, and a QR code for the app identifier.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component with background image, company branding, service description, and call-to-action buttons that scroll to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/ServiceAreaMap.t: Service area map component displaying a coverage map image with an overlay listing served areas and a prompt to contact for unlisted locations.
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Services section component displaying four AC service offerings (Installation, Repair, Maintenance, Emergency Service) in a responsive card grid layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, automatically invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBookingForm.ts: Custom hook for handling booking form submissions, converting dates to nanoseconds and calling the backend actor's submitBooking method with toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Custom hook for handling contact form submissions, calling the backend actor's submitMessage method with timestamp conversion and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm orange/blue-gray color scheme for light and dark modes, optimized for an AC services brand.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including color schemes using OKLCH color space, typography settings with Inter font, container queries, animations, and custom border radius and shadow utilities.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for an AC services website documenting implemented features including hero section, services listing, contact form, about section, footer, booking system, and various UI improvements with email notifications disabled.
